definitions.explanation: The seat in a vehicle where the driver sits. In Japan, this is on the right side of the car.

examples.japanese: {運転席|うんてんせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: To sit in the driver's seat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{運転席|うんてんせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{右側|みぎがわ}→右側：24189_migigawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In Japanese cars, the driver's seat is on the right side.

examples.japanese: {運転席|うんてんせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れていた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{助手席|じょしゅせき}→助手席：14738_joshuseki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{乗|の}り{込|こ}んだ→乗り込む：04618_norikomu⟧。
examples.english: The driver's side door was broken, so I got in from the passenger side.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧ (driving) + ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧ (seat)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運転席|うんてんせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧: to sit in the driver's seat
- {運転席|うんてんせき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧: to get out of the driver's seat
- {運転席|うんてんせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧: driver's side door
- {運転席|うんてんせき}⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧: the driver's side

CAR SEATS:
- {運転席|うんてんせき}: driver's seat
- ⟦{助手席|じょしゅせき}→助手席：14738_joshuseki⟧: front passenger seat
- ⟦{後部座席|こうぶざせき}→後部座席：22157_koubuzaseki⟧: back seat, rear seat

USAGE:
In Japan, cars are right-hand drive (⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦ハンドル→ハンドル：06331_handoru⟧), so the {運転席|うんてんせき} is on the right side. This is the opposite of most countries. Also used for trains, buses, and other vehicles.
